name: mummy
languages: the languages it knew in life

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can use its [[/item .8Jju4CVZaIDab6Ju]]{Dreadful Glare} and makes one attack with its [[/item .ik1IkSZi4fpiGbB3]]{rotting fist}.

actions.name: rotting fist
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or be cursed with mummy rot. The cursed target can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and its body turns to dust. The curse lasts until removed by the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.XZhdgVK3cLoxNCQl]{Remove Curse} spell or other magic.

actions.name: dreadful glare
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} targets [[lookup @labels.description.affects activity=vBP1Ivo8gjkv4DVp]] it can see within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=vBP1Ivo8gjkv4DVp]] of it. If the target can see the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw against this magic or become &reference[frightened] until the end of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also &reference[paralyzed] for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the [[lookup @item.name]] of all mummies (but not mummy lords) for the next 24 hours.
